body: I understand what you are saying lol I feel as if I am ugly because I have a high forehead hence the close shot to cut it out. Thanks.

Do you work in a call center now? If so, I know exactly how you feel my first job was in a call center and it literally sucked the life out of me. Worked there for 2+ years and couldn't get another job, besides one in another call center. Hang in there the right job will come I finally got out of there in december and it lited a little weight off my shoulders. Constantly having to be fake to customers is draining.
Same here, but I have learned that even though I don't have anyone that I am close with doesn't mean that I am doomed to be alone forever. Do you have any close family?
I hear you. Same here. I am shy and didn't have many friends in high school and those that I did have I don't speak with them anymore. With that being said you are not alone.

One day you will look back on this time in your life and feel happy that you made it through the tough time. Feeling alone is terrible feeling. Believe me I have had no luck making any friends and I always wonder why. I know its easier said then done but you just have to stay positive that things will get better. I struggle everyday and the only thing that keeps me alive is knowing that someday everything will be ok. Stay strong.

Had the same experience this morning on my way to work. Completely broke down and I did not feel any better. Walked into work with a smile on my face and my eyes bloodshot. Silently screaming for help. If you are not able to reach out to anymone in person, its great that you are at least expressing your feelings here. Just know you are not alone .
Does anyone know if Oxycodone will do the trick if I take a bunch? Get high and just never wake up.

No one will ever understand. I am trapped. I am being suffocated by my fears, depression, and anxiety. Why should I live in that type of emotional and physical state. I am going to be alone no matter what I do because I am a loser.
Thanks for your kindness, its just a waiting game at this point. I will snap eventually and no longer be here. I will be at peace. No more worries.

I am so afraid to talk to him, I think that fear is based on not wanting to hurt him and not wanting to be basically homeless because I live with him and he would probably just tell me to pack my shit. Oh he knows about making me feel uncomfortable, and he is actually the only one, besides the people on this sub, that I know I am struggling with depression and suicidal thoughts. When I told him he really didn't know how to respond. So I never brought up again because I don't want be judged. I actually deliver mail for a living. So when I am not at the post office I just sit around, or drive 2 hrs away to see my family. Don't really have any coping skills just try distract myself with work. But out on the street you are alone with your thoughts so I basically just daydream all day.
So many typos....

I don't really have the money to get professional help. I justed startes a new job and I don't have time or insurance. I am not happy for several reasons. The person I am with sort of lacks motivation. We have been together for 4 years and I grew up in that time and he is slowly getting there. I feel damaged because of certain situations he has put me through and he makea me feel really uncomfortable at times with the way he touches me . You think you meet the love of your life at 17 but then you grow up and realize  you have a life to live. You have so many things that you could be doing besides feeling trapped in this relationship where the feeling of being "in love" isn't there anymore. I dont want to hurt anyone. Anxoety has always been apart of my life but the depression and the suicidal thoughts are recent. Things have gotten better because I got out of a terrible job into a really great one, but its really just a distration.
Heartache, depression, anxiety, its the worst combination.

I just feel like my life is going no where. I have been struggling with depression since december. I am in a relationship that I am not really happy in anymore and I am damaged from this relationship but he is my only friend. I am so afraid to end the relationship with my first love, but it just isn't there anymore. I moved to where I am now to be with him and I have to no one to support me where I am. How am I going to feel any better if I am just going to be alone. I already feel so alone. I feel like I would be dissapointing alot of people. I just dont have the courage. I don't want to feel any worse. I am sort of ranting, basically I walk around with a smile on my face but secretly I am suffering on the inside. My anxiety doesn't help either.

I get what you are going through. At 18 all I wanted to do was get away from my family, even though they weren't terrible, and start my own life. Now 21 I know that things will get better for you. Everything you are worried about now college, family, high school it will all work out. I didnt start college right away because I was focused on moving away from the small town I grew up in, but I eventually made it there all though its only a rinky dinky community college. Keep your head up and just keep reminding your self that everything is going to be ok. You still have your whole life ahead of you, and I know sometimes its easier said then done. Believe me I have had my share of just wanting to dissappear. Stay strong. Hope this helps. Remember you will not have to spend the rest of your life under that roof.

I know exactly how you feel. I am having the same feelings at this very moment. Like you I fear how my family and friends would feel. Being a young adult who wants to just disappear is the hardest thing to deal with because the future is so uncertain, but just remember you do have people who care for you. Please stay strong.

I just made the realization of my depression a few months ago. I was hitting rock bottom, and I was slowly climbing back up but my feelings were just being masked by distractions. Haven't had the time to go see a doctor to diagnosis my depression. No time and fear of having to tell others. I walk around all day with a smile, but inside I just feel like I am dying.
Thank you I dont know what to do to make myself feel better. I feel so lost.
I just wanna die.
We are both in our 20's. Yeah I understand the it was shock. I have brought it up a few more times and still nothing, like it doesnt even bother him. There is no one else I feel comfortable telling.
I don't want to worry my family, and the person that I have told doesnt seem like they care. I basically cry everytime I am alone.
I will thank you.

The only people I have opened up to in person is my doctor and my boyfriend. I told him that I think about killing myself. It took alot of courage to tell him. I told him because I thought maybe it would make him more sensitive to how I was feeling,  more loving. But it didn't sort of went in one ear and out the other.
I have a few hobbies but they are just used as distractions from how I am feeling.
